# DATAPULSE SOCIAL

> We engineer UbD-driven learning systems that reduce cognitive overload and build the workforce competencies needed for a tech-savvy, machine-ready, high-performance workforce.

## About

DATAPULSE SOCIAL is a curriculum engineering company specializing in UbD-aligned learning systems that reduce cognitive overload and build workforce competencies. Our solutions prepare organizations for a tech-enabled future by producing skilled, machine-ready talent capable of performing at high levels in modern environments. We don't create curriculum — we engineer performance-driven learning infrastructure.

## Approach

Our curriculum design is built on Understanding by Design (UbD) principles, structured across Stage 1 (desired results), Stage 2 (evidence), and Stage 3 (learning plan). This ensures every unit develops real workforce competencies while minimizing cognitive overload for learners.

## Services

- **Curriculum Design** — UbD-driven course frameworks with Stage 1, 2, and 3 structure, learning objectives, and competency mapping
- **Course Content Creation** — Lesson materials, reading packs, slide decks, and written content optimized for cognitive load
- **Assessment & Evaluation** — Competency-based quizzes, projects, rubrics, and workforce readiness evaluations
- **Learning Experience Design (LXD)** — Instructional design and learning science applied to build content that sticks
- **Course Audits & Revamps** — Review, refresh, and restructure existing courses to meet modern workforce standards
- **Training & Support** — Instructor onboarding, facilitator guides, and ongoing content maintenance

## Workforce Competency Focus

Our learning systems are engineered to produce:
- Tech-savvy talent prepared for advanced technology environments
- Competence-proven professionals verified through meaningful assessments
- Machine-ready workforce capable of operating in automated and AI-driven settings
- High-performance teams built on structured skill development

## Pricing

Monthly subscription plans:

- Basic — $41/month (single course, up to 10 modules, basic assessments, 2 revision rounds, email support)
- Professional — $108/month (full curriculum design, up to 30 modules, advanced assessments, unlimited revisions, multimedia content, priority support)
- Enterprise — $250/month (multi-program development, unlimited modules, custom branding, LMS integration, training workshops, dedicated account manager)

Payments are processed securely via Stripe.
